name: Scheme of Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and Beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
unchecked_criteria: PM CARES Children Scheme beneficiaries of any category can also apply under this scheme; confirm the route in the official guidelines

Coaching must be for a covered exam (UPSC, State Civil Services, SSC, RRB, Banking, Insurance, PSU, JEE, NEET, CAT, CMAT, CLAT, GRE, GMAT, SAT, IELTS, TOEFL, IES, CA-CPT, GATE, Commercial Pilot Licence, NDA, CDS)
Generally at least 50% marks in Class 10 (for Class 12-level exams) or Class 12 (for undergraduate-level exams); confirm the exact rule for your exam
Selection is through empanelled Central Universities; Aadhaar-based attendance is mandatory
A maximum of two benefits are permitted under applicable coaching schemes
benefit: Free coaching with fee limits by course (e.g. up to Rs 75,000 for UPSC/State Civil Services, JEE/NEET, IES, CA-CPT/GATE; Rs 40,000 SSC/RRB; Rs 50,000 Banking/Insurance/PSU/CLAT and CAT/CMAT; Rs 35,000 GRE/GMAT/SAT/IELTS/TOEFL; Rs 30,000 Commercial Pilot Licence; Rs 20,000 NDA/CDS), plus Rs 4,000 monthly stipend for up to 12 months and a Rs 15,000 incentive for eligible civil services Mains qualifiers appearing for interview. About 3,500 seats a year.
documents: PM CARES beneficiary certificate and ID, where applicable
